description: 20 POST /query strings grounded in live Neo4j sampling (papers, authors, Keyword nodes, venues, institutions, highly cited titles).

cyphers_run: Counts and random samples: Paper nodes tagged via HAS_TOPIC to machine learning / deep learning / reinforcement learning / computer vision

Venues with between 30 and 200 papers (random order)
Institutions with between 50 and 400 distinct affiliated authors (random order)
Highly cited Paper titles by counting incoming CITES relationships
Paper samples under materials/chemistry-related Keyword labels
